title: Arabizi pair
description: One Lebanese Arabizi sentence and its Lebanese Arabic-script spelling (docs/SPELLING.md). One JSON object per line in data/pairs/*.jsonl. Documented in docs/DATA.md.

id.description: Unique id. Prefix by method: hw = hand, rv = rule_variant, pb = public, ai = ai_checked.

arabizi.description: The Latin-script message, exactly as typed.

arabic.description: The primary Arabic-script spelling, following docs/SPELLING.md.

accepted.description: Row-specific accepted variants: primary text in `arabic` -> other accepted spellings. Global variants live in data/rules/accepted_variants.json.

writer.description: Who wrote the Arabizi side: a person, a script name, or a provider/model for ai_checked.

checked_by.description: Who checked the row, e.g. moustafa-delayed. null until checked.

source.description: hand-written, a dataset name (public), a generator name (rule_variant) or a prompt file (ai_checked).

parent.description: rule_variant only: id of the train row this variant was made from.
